caption:
Decaying 15%? Don't type 0.15.

A 15% loss each week keeps 85%, so the factor is 0.85. Graph y = 800(0.85)^x and y = 200, then click the crossing.

Save this for test day.
tiktok_caption: 15% decay means multiply by 0.85, not 0.15. Then let Desmos find the crossing.

youtube.title: Exponential Decay in Desmos: Use 0.85, Not 0.15
youtube.description: Build the decay model with factor 0.85, graph it against y = 200, and round the crossing. SAT-style practice question (original).
